title: An accurate deep learning model for wheezing in children using real world data
summary: In a prospective single-hospital cohort of 76 children, a 34-layer residual CNN with attention analyzed wheeze audio alongside clinical features; reported accuracy was 91.2% and AUC 0.891. Model development and evaluation occurred within the study cohort, so prospective recruitment does not establish prospective model testing or clinical benefit.
